ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the straight lines $AB$ and $CD$ intersect at the point $O$, $OE \perp CD$ with the foot of the perpendicular at point $O$. If $\angle BOE = 40^\circ 6'$, what is the degree measure of $\angle AOC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
Solution: Since $OE \perp CD$, \\
therefore $\angle EOC = 90^\circ$.\\
Since $\angle BOE = 40^\circ6'$, \\
therefore $\angle AOC = 180^\circ - 90^\circ - 40^\circ6' = \boxed{49^\circ54'}$.
